get.description: Liveness, version and the commit the image was built from.

Ready when the database answers and the worker heartbeat is younger
than 3 minutes (ROLE=all runs the worker in this process).
Whether the first-run page is open (no user exists yet).
200 while no user exists, 404 once one does.

post.description: Create the first admin and sign in; 404 once any user exists.
Sign in. 401 for a wrong address or password, 423 while locked.
End this session.

get.description: The signed-in user and the CSRF token of this session.
Users ordered by e-mail address.

post.description: Create an account; 409 when the address is taken.

patch.description: Change the role, disable or enable, or set a new password.

delete.description: Delete an account and its sessions; its tokens stay, without a creator.

get.description: Every token, revoked ones included, oldest first. Never the value.

post.description: Create a token. Its value is in this answer only.

delete.description: Revoke a token. Revoking it again changes nothing.

get.description: Clients ordered by name; archived true lists the archived ones.

post.description: Create a client; 409 when another client has the name.

patch.description: Change the name, notes, aliases, or archive and restore.

delete.description:
Delete a client and everything recorded for it, for good.

confirm_name must equal the client's name; 409 otherwise.

post.description:
Archive a client: hidden from the default list, its jobs not counted.
PATCH archived false restores it.

get.description: Jobs ordered by name, filtered by client, name, state, kind or pack.

post.description:
Create a job; 422 names an unusable schedule, 409 a name the client
already uses.

get.description:
Jobs that are not archived, of clients that are not archived, as CSV.

The columns are those of the import; a cell that a spreadsheet would read
as a formula starts with an apostrophe.

200.description: The jobs as CSV (UTF-8 with a byte order mark).

post.description:
Create or update jobs from CSV, matched by client and job name.

A client that does not exist yet is created. An empty cell takes the
default; a column the file lacks keeps an existing job's value. Rows with
an error are left out and reported by row number (the first line is row 1);
the other rows are imported. dry_run checks everything and saves nothing.

patch.description:
Change a job. Sent schedule fields are checked together with the stored
ones; moving a job to another client keeps its ping URL.

post.description:
Pause a job: no state or alerts while paused. Without until it stays
paused until resumed; until must be in the future.
End a pause now.

Archive a job: hidden from the default list, never evaluated. PATCH
archived false restores it.
The next count times after `after` (default now), in UTC and local time.

get.description: Inboxes, oldest first.

post.description: Create an inbox. A webhook inbox's token is in this answer only.

patch.description:
Change the label, the sender allowlist, the Authentication-Results rule
or (IMAP inboxes) the IMAP settings. A password sent replaces the stored
one; none sent keeps it, except that a new host, port, TLS setting or user
name needs the password again (422).

delete.description:
Delete an inbox: its address, URL and token stop working at once. Its
messages stay, without an inbox, until the retention purge.

post.description: A new token for a webhook inbox, shown once; the old one stops working.

get.description: Messages, newest first.
One message: headers, readable text (at most 256 KB) and its results.
Results, newest first; job_id and status narrow the list.

post.description:
Record a run. With job_id or ping_token the result belongs to that job
(404 when there is none); with client_hint and job_name the matcher binds
it when it is sure of the job, else it waits in Unmatched (job_id null).

get.description: One job's results, newest first; 404 for an unknown job.

post.description:
Store one raw message (RFC 822 bytes as the body) in an smtp or webhook
inbox; the same message twice is stored once (duplicate true).
The job's run ended well; answers OK.

get.description: The job's run ended well; answers OK.

post.description: start: the job's run began; fail: it failed. Answers OK.

get.description: start: the job's run began; fail: it failed. Answers OK.

post.description: Store an uploaded .eml file in an inbox, as if it had been received.

get.description: Parser packs ordered by id, built-in and custom, without their YAML.

post.description:
Save a custom pack from a Pack YAML file, under the id it names; 201
when it is new. The same rules as PUT.

Run the enabled packs, and the pack being edited, on a pasted mail:
every pack's score, the pack that claims it and the results with their
spans. 30 tests a minute per user; 503 when the bench does not answer
within its time.

schema.title: PackTestRequest
schema.description:
A mail (RFC 822 text as pasted) and, optionally, the Pack YAML being
edited, which takes the place of the stored pack with its id.

put.description:
Create or replace a custom pack (201 when new). Built-in packs answer
409; a changed pack must raise its version.

get.description: The pack as a Pack YAML file (import takes it back).

200.description: The Pack YAML as a file.

post.description: The pack parses mail again (from the worker's next tick).
The pack stops parsing mail (from the worker's next tick).

get.description: Results no job is bound to, newest first.

post.description:
Bind the result to a job; 422 for an unknown job, 409 when the result
is bound already.

get.description:
A daily schedule at the median time of the runs with this result's job
name and client hint (the result included), in timezone (default: the
digest zone of Settings). 422 with fewer than 3 runs.

post.description:
Create a job from the result and bind the result to it. 409 when the
client has a job of that name, or the result is bound already.

get.description:
A heartbeat older than 3 minutes (or none) is stale: the web app shows a
red banner and /readyz answers 503.

BenchMail.title: BenchMail
BenchMail.description:
The mail as the engine reads it: decoded headers and the visible text
(HTML as text, at most 256 KiB). Span offsets point into these.

BenchSpan.title: BenchSpan
BenchSpan.description:
Characters start to end of source (body, subject, from or to) hold the
value of field (job_name, details.size, status, ...).

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description:
The result is bound to job_id. match_key_set: the job had no match key
and now has the result's job name; alias_added: the result's client hint
became an alias of the client. Both make the next identical mail bind.
also_bound: other unmatched results with the same names bound as well.

CreateJobRequest.title: CreateJobRequest
CreateJobRequest.description:
A job made from an unmatched result, for an existing client (client_id)
or a client by name (client_name: found, or created). name defaults to the
result's job name and match_key to it as well. Without schedule_kind and
schedule_expr the job runs daily at the time suggest-schedule gives (from
one result on); timezone defaults to the digest time zone of Settings.

CreatedToken.title: CreatedToken
CreatedToken.description: The new token with its value. The value is shown this once only.

FieldProblem.title: FieldProblem
FieldProblem.description: One invalid input: where it is (for example body.email) and why.

ImapPatch.title: ImapPatch
ImapPatch.description: Only the fields sent change; a password replaces the stored one.

ImapSettings.title: ImapSettings
ImapSettings.description: A mailbox the MSP already collects alert mail in.

ImportProblem.title: ImportProblem
ImportProblem.description: A row that was not imported. Row 1 is the header line.

InboxCreated.title: InboxCreated
InboxCreated.description: The new inbox; webhook_token is in this answer only (webhook inboxes).

InboxPatch.title: InboxPatch
InboxPatch.description: Only the fields sent change. The kind and the code never change.

InboxToken.title: InboxToken
InboxToken.description: A webhook inbox's new token, shown this once; the old one stops working.

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description: A job; its state is paused or unknown until the evaluator keeps it (C7).

JobPatch.title: JobPatch
JobPatch.description: Only the fields sent change; null clears parser_pack_id and match_key.

MessageAccepted.title: MessageAccepted
MessageAccepted.description:
The stored message, or for a duplicate the earlier one; the worker
parses it (parse_state pending).

NewResult.title: NewResult
NewResult.description:
A run reported by a script (POST results). The job is named by job_id,
by ping_token, or by client_hint and job_name for the matcher.

PackBody.title: PackBody
PackBody.description: A custom pack as Pack YAML; its id must be the id in the URL.

PackProblem.title: PackProblem
PackProblem.description:
One problem of a parser pack: a JSON Pointer into the pack ("" for the
whole document) and why.

PackTestAnswer.title: PackTestAnswer
PackTestAnswer.description:
What the packs make of the mail.

claimed_by: the pack that claims the mail among the enabled packs (with
the edited one), null for no claim or a tie. outcome: parsed (results of
pack_id: the edited pack when one was sent, else the claiming pack),
unmatched (reason no-pack, tie with the candidates, or no-records) or
error (reason timeout, deadline, too-many-records or memory, at path).
skipped: stored packs that no longer load and were left out.

PauseRequest.title: PauseRequest
PauseRequest.description: Without until the job stays paused until it is resumed.

ResultAccepted.title: ResultAccepted
ResultAccepted.description: The stored result; job_id is null until the matcher binds it.

SchedulePreview.title: SchedulePreview
SchedulePreview.description: The next times, or why the schedule cannot be used (error and field).

ScheduleSuggestion.title: ScheduleSuggestion
ScheduleSuggestion.description:
A daily schedule at the median time of the job's runs: expr is HH:MM in
timezone; basis is the time read of each run; results how many runs.

UnmatchedOut.title: UnmatchedOut
UnmatchedOut.description: A result no job is bound to yet.

UserPatch.title: UserPatch
UserPatch.description: Only the fields sent change. A new password also clears a lockout.
